title: Les Misérables (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Jean Valjean, who has spent 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, tries to turn his life around by taking on a new identity and becoming a respected member of society. He promises Fantine, a factory worker who is dying, that he will care for her daughter Cosette, who is being mistreated by the Thénardier family. Valjean raises Cosette as his own child, but Inspector Javert keeps chasing him, determined to prove Valjean is still a criminal.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Jean Valjean因偷竊一條麵包而被判監十九年，出獄後嘗試改寫人生，以新身份重新做人，成為社會上受尊敬的一員。他向臨終彌留的女工Fantine承諾，會照顧她的女兒Cosette，而當時Cosette正遭受Thénardier一家虐待。Valjean視Cosette如己出般撫養她，然而探長Javert一直追捕他，一心要證明Valjean仍是罪犯。
